description: Codex permission prompt (no widget edge: its rows are unframed) whose heredoc writes a row starting with a literal │ and a row of only ━━━. With no frame found, only the terminal's right padding is stripped: those rows are command content and stay in the context, the push identity, so commands differing by them never share one. Synthetic.
